history.summary: 500-unit D19 Serangoon leasehold (1995), 2BR at $1.65M / $1,803psf, 120m from CC14 Lorong Chuan MRT. Genuinely odd profile: strong 6.40% URA over 69 txns and great transit, yet the lowest arena score in the batch (MMR 1483 / score 303) and asking ~13% above the $1,594 URA median. The price premium against a 31-year-old leasehold is the core problem.
history.rating_rationale: Lorong Chuan MRT at 120m and a 6.40%/yr URA are real positives, but the $1,803psf ask is roughly 13% above the $1,594 URA median for a 1995 leasehold (~69 yrs remaining and falling), which is why the technical engine scores it a batch-low 303. The estate recently spent on upgrading, reducing near-term en-bloc odds (Chuan Park next door already redeveloped). You are paying up for transit on an ageing lease — fair as a home, weak as a 5-7yr investment at this premium. Neutral.

history.summary: A spacious 1,475 sqft 99LH 3BR at $1,322 psf, ~17% below the district median PSF of $1,594, with a 500-unit base and an MRT literally at the doorstep (120m to Lorong Chuan). Strong resale CAGR (6.4%/yr, 69 txns), deep liquidity and a sub-$2M entry make this a credible value play despite the 1995 vintage.
history.rating_rationale: Entry PSF $1,322 vs URA median $1,594 is a genuine ~17% discount on a large-format unit, and the 6.4%/yr resale-only appreciation over 69 transactions is well above the OCR baseline. 120m to Lorong Chuan MRT and Serangoon NEX nearby anchor both rental and resale demand; 500 units gives a deep buyer pool. Real en-bloc optionality (377,682 sqft land, second-largest in the cluster) is a tail upside, though the estate just spent on upgrading so it is not imminent. Knocked off Strong Buy by 31-year age (remaining lease ~68yr, financing/maintenance headwinds building) and reported pest/security gripes.
red_flags: 1995 vintage — ~68 years lease remaining, approaching the <70yr financing/CPF caution band over the hold
Older estate: resident complaints about pest control and security staff; dated facilities vs newer competitors
Recent estate upgrading spend dampens near-term en-bloc probability
catalysts: 120m to Lorong Chuan MRT (Circle Line) plus Serangoon NEX/NE interchange nearby — strong transit and retail anchor
Large 377,682 sqft site = real long-run en-bloc optionality with unblocked landed-estate views
Sub-$2M entry on a 1,475 sqft 3BR keeps it in the deepest buyer band for HDB upgraders
